ruleGlossary.fullServiceInterfaceMethod: A method declared on a full (read+write) service interface.
ruleGlossary.crossSectionFullService: A constructor dependency on a full-service interface (or concrete service) owned by a different section.
ruleGlossary.longMethod: A method's nonblank line count exceeds 40; points scale with length (steeper past 100 and 180 lines).
ruleGlossary.dtoScalarProperty: A public scalar property on a type classified as a DTO.
ruleGlossary.publicDtoType: A public type classified as a DTO with at least one public property and no business-logic methods.
ruleGlossary.cognitiveComplexity: A method's SonarSource cognitive-complexity score (nesting-weighted branching) exceeds the threshold; points scale with the excess.
ruleGlossary.methodParameterOverflow: A public method has more than two parameters; points scale per parameter beyond two.
ruleGlossary.crossSectionReadInterface: A constructor dependency on a read-service interface owned by a different section.
ruleGlossary.readServiceInterfaceMethod: A method declared on a read-only service interface.
ruleGlossary.largeClass: A service/repository/controller class's nonblank line count exceeds 750; points scale with size (steeper past 1500 lines).
ruleGlossary.parameterBagInput: An input/command/request type with four or more data members, a direct-assignment constructor, and no behavior, used as the sole or near-sole parameter of a public method — a long method signature folded into an object without adding invariants or domain semantics.
ruleGlossary.mutationModeParameter: A public mutation method takes an action/mode enum parameter that selects behavior, even when the body is small and does not delegate; the parameter folds multiple distinct operations behind one signature.
ruleGlossary.backgroundJob: A background job, hosted service, or worker class.
ruleGlossary.controllerAction: A public action method on a controller.
ruleGlossary.readSurfaceProjectionMethod: A read-service-interface method returns a projection, predicate, scalar fact, or composed view rather than the section's primary Info DTO.
ruleGlossary.oneImplementationInterface: A classified interface has exactly one classified class implementing it.
ruleGlossary.dtoCollectionProperty: A public collection-typed property on a DTO.
ruleGlossary.booleanParameter: A public method has a boolean parameter (often a control flag that splits the method into hidden branches).
ruleGlossary.missingReadSurface: A repo-backed section has no read-only service interface.
ruleGlossary.missingPrimaryInfoDto: A repo-backed section has no DTO matching its primary Info DTO name.
ruleGlossary.optionsBag: A public method takes a single parameter whose type aggregates many public properties (heuristic: name ends in 'Options' with 4+ props, or any type with 6+ public props).
ruleGlossary.writeCapableInterfaceUsedReadOnly: A class injects a full-service interface that is paired (by inheritance or by a same-namespace 'Read'-suffixed sibling) with a read-only interface, and every observed invocation on the injected dependency targets a method that also exists on the read interface.
ruleGlossary.dtoNestedProperty: A public property on a DTO whose type is another non-primitive (often another DTO).
ruleGlossary.applicationServiceMethod: A public method on a concrete application-service class.
ruleGlossary.inlineParameterObjectConstruction: A public method call constructs an input/request/options object inline from a long argument list, moving the argument bundle from the method signature to the construction site.
ruleGlossary.actionDispatcher: A method that mutates state dispatches on a parameter via a switch or if-chain whose arms route to different members with disjoint bodies (low arm cohesion); read methods and arms sharing a base body are exempt.
ruleGlossary.tupleReturn: A public method's return type is a value tuple.
ruleGlossary.dashboardAdminPageName: A public method's name contains 'Dashboard', 'ForAdmin', 'ForPage', or 'AdminPage' — caller-shaped naming that often signals a leaked UI concern.
ruleGlossary.missingWriteSurface: A repo-backed section has no write/full service interface.
ruleGlossary.newRepositoryInterface: A repository interface type — each is durable infrastructure surface.
ruleGlossary.crossSectionRepository: A constructor dependency on a repository interface or implementation owned by a different section.
ruleGlossary.repositoryInterfaceMethod: A method declared on a repository interface.
ruleGlossary.flagsControlFlow: A method that mutates state branches on a [Flags] enum parameter via HasFlag or bitwise tests; read methods are exempt.
ruleGlossary.canonicalReadDtoReturn: A method's return type is a section's canonical read DTO (credit; encourages adoption of the project-blessed read API).
